title: 专利审查指南（第二部分节选）
titleEn: Guidelines for Patent Examination (Part II, selected)
version: 2023 年版，经国家知识产权局令第 84 号修改（2026 年 1 月 1 日起施行）
versionEn: 2023 edition as amended by CNIPA Order No. 84 (in force 1 January 2026)
enLabel: Claude 英译（术语对齐专利法官方英译）
note: 国家知识产权局没有发布现行指南的官方英文版。英文为 Claude 译，术语尽量与全国人大专利法英译一致；正式文件以中文为准。

units.label: 第二部分第二章 2.1.3
units.title: Sufficiency of disclosure (enablement)
units.titleZh: 能够实现

paras.en: “A person skilled in the relevant field of technology can carry it out” means that such a person, following what is stated in the description, can carry out the technical solution of the invention or utility model, solve its technical problem and achieve the expected technical effect.
paras.zh: 所属技术领域的技术人员能够实现，是指所属技术领域的技术人员按照说明书记载的内容，就能够实现该发明或者实用新型的技术方案，解决其技术问题，并且产生预期的技术效果。

paras.en: Where the examiner has a reasonable ground to doubt that the invention or utility model is sufficiently disclosed, the examiner shall require the applicant to clarify.
paras.zh: 审查员如果有合理的理由质疑发明或者实用新型没有达到充分公开的要求，则应当要求申请人予以澄清。

paras.en: (5) the description gives a specific technical solution but no experimental evidence, while the solution can only be established by experimental results.
paras.zh: （5）说明书中给出了具体的技术方案，但未给出实验证据，而该方案又必须依赖实验结果加以证实才能成立。

paras.en: For example, for an invention relating to a new use of a known compound, the description normally needs to provide experimental evidence confirming the stated use and effect; otherwise the requirement of enablement is not met.
paras.zh: 例如，对于已知化合物的新用途发明，通常情况下，需要在说明书中给出实验证据来证实其所述的用途以及效果，否则将无法达到能够实现的要求。

phrases.en: the description does not disclose the invention sufficiently / the invention is insufficiently disclosed
does not comply with Article 26, paragraph 3, of the Patent Law
phrases.zh: 不符合专利法第二十六条第三款的规定

phrases.en: a person skilled in the art cannot carry out the invention
phrases.zh: 所属技术领域的技术人员无法实现

phrases.en: there is no experimental evidence
the expected technical effect

units.label: 第二部分第二章 3.2.1
units.title: Claims supported by the description
units.titleZh: 以说明书为依据

paras.en: “The claims shall be based on the description” means that the claims shall be supported by the description.
paras.zh: 权利要求书应当以说明书为依据，是指权利要求应当得到说明书的支持。

paras.en: The technical solution claimed in each claim shall be one that a person skilled in the art can obtain or generalize from what is sufficiently disclosed in the description, and shall not go beyond the scope of the disclosure in the description.
paras.zh: 权利要求书中的每一项权利要求所要求保护的技术方案应当是所属技术领域的技术人员能够从说明书充分公开的内容中得到或概括得出的技术方案，并且不得超出说明书公开的范围。

paras.en: Where a generalization in a claim contains matter that the applicant has merely speculated and whose effect is difficult to determine and assess in advance, the generalization shall be regarded as going beyond the scope of the disclosure in the description.
paras.zh: 如果权利要求的概括包含申请人推测的内容，而其效果又难于预先确定和评价，应当认为这种概括超出了说明书公开的范围。

paras.en: Where the generalization gives a person skilled in the art good reason to doubt that one or more of the specific concepts or alternatives covered by the generic or parallel generalization can solve the technical problem of the invention or utility model and achieve the same technical effect, the claim shall be regarded as not supported by the description.
paras.zh: 如果权利要求的概括使所属技术领域的技术人员有充分理由怀疑该上位概括或并列概括所包含的一种或多种下位概念或选择方式不能解决发明或者实用新型所要解决的技术问题，并达到相同的技术效果，则应当认为该权利要求没有得到说明书的支持。

phrases.en: the claim is not supported by the description
phrases.zh: 权利要求得不到说明书的支持

phrases.en: the claim is generalized to a broad scope
phrases.zh: 概括了一个较宽的保护范围

phrases.en: generic generalization (a generic term covering several species)
alternatives (Markush group)
matter speculated by the applicant
there is good reason to doubt that …

units.label: 第二部分第二章 3.2.2
units.title: Clarity of claims
units.titleZh: 清楚

paras.en: The claims shall be clear in two respects: each claim shall be clear, and all the claims taken as a whole shall also be clear.
paras.zh: 权利要求书应当清楚，一是指每一项权利要求应当清楚，二是指构成权利要求书的所有权利要求作为一个整体也应当清楚。

paras.en: A claim shall not use terms of uncertain meaning such as “thick”, “thin”, “strong”, “weak”, “high temperature”, “high pressure” or “a wide range”, unless the term has a generally accepted, precise meaning in the particular field, such as “high frequency” in an amplifier.
paras.zh: 权利要求中不得使用含义不确定的用语，如“厚”“薄”“强”“弱”“高温”“高压”“很宽范围”等，除非这种用语在特定技术领域中具有公认的确切含义，如放大器中的“高频”。

paras.en: A claim shall not contain expressions such as “for example”, “preferably”, “in particular” or “where necessary”.
paras.zh: 权利要求中不得出现“例如”“最好是”“尤其是”“必要时”等类似用语。

paras.en: In general, a claim shall not use expressions such as “about”, “close to”, “etc.” or “or the like”, because they usually make the scope of the claim unclear.
paras.zh: 在一般情况下，权利要求中不得使用“约”“接近”“等”“或类似物”等类似的用语，因为这类用语通常会使权利要求的范围不清楚。

phrases.en: the claim is unclear / the claim lacks clarity
the scope of protection is unclear
a term of uncertain meaning (US: a relative term / term of degree)
lacks antecedent basis
the subject matter (title) of the claim

units.label: 第二部分第三章 3.1
units.title: Principles for examining novelty
units.titleZh: 新颖性审查原则

paras.en: If their technical field, the technical problem solved, the technical solution and the expected effect are substantially the same, the two are regarded as the identical invention or utility model.
paras.zh: 如果其技术领域、所解决的技术问题、技术方案和预期效果实质上相同，则认为两者为同样的发明或者实用新型。

paras.en: (2) Separate comparison. When novelty is assessed, each claim shall be compared separately with each item of prior art, or with the relevant content of each earlier-filed, later-published application; it shall not be compared with a combination of several items of prior art or several such applications, or with a combination of several technical solutions in one reference document.
paras.zh: （2）单独对比判断新颖性时，应当将发明或者实用新型专利申请的各项权利要求分别与每一项现有技术或者申请在先公布或者公告在后的发明或者实用新型的相关技术内容单独地进行比较，不得将其与几项现有技术或者申请在先公布或者公告在后的发明或者实用新型内容的组合、或者与一份对比文件中的多项技术方案的组合进行对比。

phrases.en: the principle of separate comparison (US: single reference rule)
reference document 1 (D1) / prior art reference D1
an earlier-filed, later-published application (conflicting application)
phrases.zh: 申请在先、公布在后的申请（抵触申请）

phrases.en: substantially the same
destroys the novelty of … / anticipates …
Claim 1 lacks novelty under Article 22, paragraph 2, of the Patent Law
phrases.zh: 权利要求1不具备专利法第二十二条第二款规定的新颖性

units.label: 第二部分第三章 3.2.2
units.title: Specific (species) and generic (genus) concepts
units.titleZh: 具体（下位）概念与一般（上位）概念

paras.en: If the claimed invention or utility model differs from a reference document only in that the former uses a generic concept and the latter a specific concept to define a technical feature of the same kind, the disclosure of the specific concept destroys the novelty of the invention or utility model defined by the generic concept.
paras.zh: 如果要求保护的发明或者实用新型与对比文件相比，其区别仅在于前者采用一般（上位）概念，而后者采用具体（下位）概念限定同类性质的技术特征，则具体（下位）概念的公开使采用一般（上位）概念限定的发明或者实用新型丧失新颖性。

paras.en: Conversely, the disclosure of a generic concept does not affect the novelty of an invention or utility model defined by a specific concept.
paras.zh: 反之，一般（上位）概念的公开并不影响采用具体（下位）概念限定的发明或者实用新型的新颖性。

phrases.en: generic concept (genus) / specific concept (species)
phrases.zh: 上位概念 / 下位概念

phrases.en: disclosure of a species anticipates the genus
phrases.zh: 下位概念的公开使上位概念丧失新颖性

units.label: 第二部分第三章 3.2.4
units.title: Numerical values and ranges
units.titleZh: 数值和数值范围

paras.en: (1) Where the value or range disclosed in the reference document falls within the claimed range, it destroys the novelty of the claimed invention or utility model.
paras.zh: （1）对比文件公开的数值或者数值范围落在上述限定的技术特征的数值范围内，将破坏要求保护的发明或者实用新型的新颖性。

paras.en: (2) Where the range disclosed in the reference document partly overlaps the claimed range or shares an end point with it, it destroys the novelty of the claimed invention or utility model.
paras.zh: （2）对比文件公开的数值范围与上述限定的技术特征的数值范围部分重叠或者有一个共同的端点，将破坏要求保护的发明或者实用新型的新颖性。

paras.en: (3) The two end points of a range disclosed in the reference document destroy the novelty of an invention or utility model whose feature is defined by discrete values including either end point, but not of one defined by any value between the two end points.
paras.zh: （3）对比文件公开的数值范围的两个端点将破坏上述限定的技术特征为离散数值并且具有该两端点中任一个的发明或者实用新型的新颖性，但不破坏上述限定的技术特征为该两端点之间任一数值的发明或者实用新型的新颖性。

paras.en: (4) Where the claimed value or range falls within the range disclosed in the reference document and shares no end point with it, the reference document does not destroy the novelty of the claimed invention or utility model.
paras.zh: （4）上述限定的技术特征的数值或者数值范围落在对比文件公开的数值范围内，并且与对比文件公开的数值范围没有共同的端点，则对比文件不破坏要求保护的发明或者实用新型的新颖性。

phrases.en: partly overlaps
a common end point
falls within the range of …
discrete values

units.label: 第二部分第三章 3.2.5
units.title: Product claims with property, parameter, use or process features
units.titleZh: 包含性能、参数、用途或者制备方法等特征的产品权利要求

paras.en: For such claims, it shall be considered whether the property or parameter features imply that the claimed product has a particular structure and/or composition.
paras.zh: 对于这类权利要求，应当考虑权利要求中的性能、参数特征是否隐含了要求保护的产品具有某种特定结构和/或组成。

paras.en: Conversely, if a person skilled in the art cannot distinguish the claimed product from the product of the reference document on the basis of the property or parameter, it may be presumed that the two products are the same, and the claim therefore lacks novelty, unless the applicant can prove, on the basis of the application or the prior art, that the claimed product differs in structure and/or composition.
paras.zh: 相反，如果所属技术领域的技术人员根据该性能、参数无法将要求保护的产品与对比文件产品区分开，则可推定要求保护的产品与对比文件产品相同，因此申请的权利要求不具备新颖性，除非申请人能够根据申请文件或者现有技术证明权利要求中包含性能、参数特征的产品与对比文件产品在结构和/或组成上不同。

paras.en: If the use is determined by an inherent property of the product itself and the use feature does not imply any change in structure and/or composition, a product claim defined by that use feature lacks novelty over the product of the reference document.
paras.zh: 如果该用途由产品本身固有的特性决定，而且用途特征没有隐含产品在结构和/或组成上发生改变，则该用途特征限定的产品权利要求相对于对比文件的产品不具有新颖性。

phrases.en: it may be presumed that … are the same
implies a particular structure and/or composition
phrases.zh: 隐含了特定结构和/或组成

phrases.en: an inherent property of the product itself
the burden shifts to the applicant to prove …
phrases.zh: 举证责任转移给申请人

phrases.en: a product-by-process claim
phrases.zh: 用制备方法表征的产品权利要求

units.label: 第二部分第四章 2.2–2.4
units.title: Prominent substantive features, obvious progress, the skilled person
units.titleZh: 突出的实质性特点、显著的进步、技术人员

paras.en: An invention has prominent substantive features if, to a person skilled in the relevant field of technology, it is non-obvious over the prior art.
paras.zh: 发明有突出的实质性特点，是指对所属技术领域的技术人员来说，发明相对于现有技术是非显而易见的。

paras.en: If a person skilled in the art could arrive at the invention on the basis of the prior art merely by logical analysis, reasoning or limited experimentation, the invention is obvious and thus has no prominent substantive features.
paras.zh: 如果发明是所属技术领域的技术人员在现有技术的基础上仅仅通过合乎逻辑的分析、推理或者有限的试验可以得到的，则该发明是显而易见的，也就不具备突出的实质性特点。

paras.en: An invention represents obvious progress if it produces a beneficial technical effect compared with the prior art.
paras.zh: 发明有显著的进步，是指发明与现有技术相比能够产生有益的技术效果。

paras.en: A person skilled in the relevant field of technology, also called a person skilled in the art, is a hypothetical “person” who is presumed to know all the common technical knowledge in the field before the filing date or priority date, to have access to all the prior art in the field, and to be able to apply routine experimental means available before that date, but who has no creativity.
paras.zh: 所属技术领域的技术人员，也可称为本领域的技术人员，是指一种假设的“人”，假定他知晓申请日或者优先权日之前发明所属技术领域所有的普通技术知识，能够获知该领域中所有的现有技术，并且具有应用该日期之前常规实验手段的能力，但他不具有创造能力。

phrases.en: prominent substantive features (official law translation)
obvious progress (official law translation)
non-obvious
logical analysis, reasoning or limited experimentation
phrases.zh: 合乎逻辑的分析、推理或者有限的试验

phrases.en: common technical knowledge / common general knowledge
phrases.zh: 普通技术知识 / 公知常识

phrases.en: routine experimental means

units.label: 第二部分第四章 3.1
units.title: Principles for examining inventiveness
units.titleZh: 创造性审查原则

paras.en: In assessing inventiveness, the examiner shall consider not only the technical solution itself but also the technical field, the technical problem solved and the technical effect produced, and shall regard the invention as a whole.
paras.zh: 在评价发明是否具备创造性时，审查员不仅要考虑发明的技术方案本身，而且还要考虑发明所属技术领域、所解决的技术问题和所产生的技术效果，将发明作为一个整体看待。

paras.en: Unlike the “separate comparison” principle for novelty (see Chapter 3, § 3.1 of this Part), inventiveness is assessed by combining different technical contents of one or more items of prior art.
paras.zh: 与新颖性“单独对比”的审查原则（参见本部分第三章第3.1节）不同，审查创造性时，将一份或者多份现有技术中的不同的技术内容组合在一起对要求保护的发明进行评价。

paras.en: If an independent claim is inventive, the inventiveness of its dependent claims is generally not examined further.
paras.zh: 如果一项独立权利要求具备创造性，则一般不再审查该独立权利要求的从属权利要求的创造性。

phrases.en: consider the invention as a whole
phrases.zh: 将发明作为一个整体看待

phrases.en: combine D1 with D2 / in combination with
independent claim / dependent claim
phrases.zh: 独立权利要求 / 从属权利要求

units.label: 第二部分第四章 3.2.1.1
units.title: The three-step test
units.titleZh: 三步法

paras.en: The closest prior art is the single technical solution in the prior art that is most closely related to the claimed invention; it is the basis for judging whether the invention has prominent substantive features.
paras.zh: 最接近的现有技术，是指现有技术中与要求保护的发明最密切相关的一个技术方案，它是判断发明是否具有突出的实质性特点的基础。

paras.en: To this end, the distinguishing features of the claimed invention over the closest prior art shall first be identified, and then the technical problem actually solved by the invention shall be determined from the technical effect those features achieve in the claimed invention.
paras.zh: 为此，首先应当分析要求保护的发明与最接近的现有技术相比有哪些区别特征，然后根据该区别特征在要求保护的发明中所能达到的技术效果确定发明实际解决的技术问题。

paras.en: The reformulated technical problem shall match the technical effect achieved by the distinguishing features in the invention; it shall not be the distinguishing features themselves, nor contain any pointer to or hint at them.
paras.zh: 重新确定的技术问题应当与区别特征在发明中所能达到的技术效果相匹配，不应当被确定为区别特征本身，也不应当包含对区别特征的指引或者暗示。

paras.en: What has to be determined is whether the prior art as a whole contains a technical teaching, that is, whether it suggests applying the distinguishing features to the closest prior art to solve its technical problem (the problem actually solved by the invention); such a teaching would motivate a person skilled in the art, faced with that problem, to modify the closest prior art and arrive at the claimed invention.
paras.zh: 判断过程中，要确定的是现有技术整体上是否存在某种技术启示，即现有技术中是否给出将上述区别特征应用到该最接近的现有技术以解决其存在的技术问题（即发明实际解决的技术问题）的启示，这种启示会使本领域的技术人员在面对所述技术问题时，有动机改进该最接近的现有技术并获得要求保护的发明。

paras.en: (i) The distinguishing feature is common general knowledge, for example a customary means in the art for solving the reformulated technical problem, or a technical means for solving it disclosed in a textbook or in a reference book such as a technical dictionary or handbook.
paras.zh: （i）所述区别特征为公知常识，例如，本领域中解决该重新确定的技术问题的惯用手段，或教科书或者技术词典、技术手册等工具书中披露的解决该重新确定的技术问题的技术手段。

phrases.en: the closest prior art
distinguishing features / differences
the technical problem actually solved (EPO: objective technical problem)
reformulate the technical problem
a technical teaching / suggestion (US: teaching, suggestion or motivation)
would be motivated to modify
common general knowledge
a customary (conventional) means
plays the same role / serves the same function

units.label: 第二部分第四章 4.3
units.title: Selection inventions
units.titleZh: 选择发明

paras.en: A selection invention is one that deliberately selects, from a broad range disclosed in the prior art, a narrower range or an individual member not mentioned in the prior art.
paras.zh: 选择发明，是指从现有技术公开的宽范围中，有目的地选出现有技术中未提到的窄范围或者个体的发明。

paras.en: In judging the inventiveness of a selection invention, the unexpected technical effect brought by the selection is the main factor to consider.
paras.zh: 在进行选择发明创造性的判断时，选择所带来的预料不到的技术效果是考虑的主要因素。

paras.en: (2) If the invention selects a specific size, temperature range or other parameter within a possible, limited range, and the selection could be obtained by a person skilled in the art by conventional means without producing an unexpected technical effect, the invention is not inventive.
paras.zh: （2）如果发明是在可能的、有限的范围内选择具体的尺寸、温度范围或者其他参数，而这些选择可以由本领域的技术人员通过常规手段得到并且没有产生预料不到的技术效果，则该发明不具备创造性。

paras.en: (4) If the selection gives the invention an unexpected technical effect, the invention has prominent substantive features and represents obvious progress, and is inventive.
paras.zh: （4）如果选择使得发明取得了预料不到的技术效果，则该发明具有突出的实质性特点和显著的进步，具备创造性。

phrases.en: a selection invention
select a narrower range from a broader one
phrases.zh: 从宽范围中选出窄范围

phrases.en: obtainable by conventional means (US: routine optimization)
an unexpected technical effect (US: unexpected results)

units.label: 第二部分第四章 5
units.title: Other factors in assessing inventiveness
units.titleZh: 判断创造性时需考虑的其他因素

paras.en: A technical prejudice is a view, widely held by technicians in a field at a certain time on a technical problem, that departs from the objective facts; it leads people away from other possibilities and hinders research and development in the field.
paras.zh: 技术偏见，是指在某段时间内、某个技术领域中，技术人员对某个技术问题普遍存在的、偏离客观事实的认识，它引导人们不去考虑其他方面的可能性，阻碍人们对该技术领域的研究和开发。

paras.en: An invention achieves an unexpected technical effect when, compared with the prior art, its effect changes in “quality”, giving a new property, or changes in “quantity” beyond what could be expected.
paras.zh: 发明取得了预料不到的技术效果，是指发明同现有技术相比，其技术效果产生“质”的变化，具有新的性能；或者产生“量”的变化，超出人们预期的想象。

paras.en: However, commercial success due to other causes, such as better sales techniques or advertising, cannot be a basis for judging inventiveness.
paras.zh: 但是，如果商业上的成功是由于其他原因所致，例如由于销售技术的改进或者广告宣传造成的，则不能作为判断创造性的依据。

phrases.en: a long-felt but unsolved technical problem (US: long-felt need)
phrases.zh: 长期渴望解决但始终未能获得成功的技术难题

phrases.en: overcomes a technical prejudice (US: the prior art teaches away)
a qualitative / quantitative change
commercial success
is directly caused by the technical features of the invention (US: nexus)
phrases.zh: 是由发明的技术特征直接导致的

units.label: 第二部分第四章 6.2–6.3
units.title: Avoiding hindsight; unexpected effects
units.titleZh: 避免“事后诸葛亮”；预料不到的效果

paras.en: Because the examiner judges inventiveness after learning what the invention is, there is a tendency to underestimate it and to fall into the error of hindsight.
paras.zh: 审查发明的创造性时，由于审查员是在了解了发明内容之后才作出判断，因而容易对发明的创造性估计偏低，从而犯“事后诸葛亮”的错误。

paras.en: As stated in § 5.3 of this Chapter, if the invention has an unexpected technical effect over the prior art, there is no need to doubt whether its technical solution has prominent substantive features; the invention can be found inventive.
paras.zh: 按照本章第5.3节中所述，如果发明与现有技术相比具有预料不到的技术效果，则不必再怀疑其技术方案是否具有突出的实质性特点，可以确定发明具备创造性。

phrases.en: hindsight (ex post facto analysis); “impermissible hindsight” in US case law
underestimate the inventiveness

units.label: 第二部分第四章 6.4（局令第 84 号修改）
units.labelEn: Part II, Ch. 4, § 6.4 (as amended by Order No. 84)
units.title: Examining the claimed invention
units.titleZh: 对要求保护的发明进行审查

paras.en: Inventiveness shall be assessed for the technical solution defined by the claim as a whole, that is, whether the technical solution is inventive, not whether a particular technical feature is inventive.
paras.zh: 在判断创造性时，应当针对权利要求限定的技术方案整体进行评价，即评价技术方案是否具备创造性，而不是评价某一技术特征是否具备创造性。

paras.en: Technical features through which the invention contributes over the prior art — for example features that give the invention an unexpected technical effect, or that show it overcomes a technical prejudice — shall be written into the claims; otherwise they are not taken into account in assessing inventiveness, even if they are stated in the description.
paras.zh: 发明对现有技术作出贡献的技术特征，例如，使发明产生预料不到的技术效果的技术特征，或者体现发明克服技术偏见的技术特征，应当写入权利要求中；否则，即使说明书中有记载，评价发明的创造性时也不予考虑。

paras.en: Features that make no contribution to solving the technical problem usually do not affect the inventiveness of the technical solution, even if they are written into the claims.
paras.zh: 对技术问题的解决没有作出贡献的特征，即使写入权利要求中，通常也不会对技术方案的创造性产生影响。

phrases.en: technical features that contribute over the prior art
phrases.zh: 对现有技术作出贡献的技术特征

phrases.en: make no contribution to solving the technical problem
phrases.zh: 对技术问题的解决没有作出贡献

phrases.en: are not taken into account / are disregarded

units.label: 第二部分第八章 2.2（2）、6.1.1
units.title: Right to be heard; conditions for refusal
units.titleZh: 听证原则与驳回条件

paras.en: During substantive examination, before making a decision of refusal the examiner shall give the applicant at least one opportunity to submit observations and/or amend the application in respect of the facts, reasons and evidence on which the refusal is based; that is, those facts, reasons and evidence must already have been notified to the applicant in a previous Office action.
paras.zh: 在实质审查过程中，审查员在作出驳回决定之前，应当给申请人提供至少一次针对驳回所依据的事实、理由和证据陈述意见和/或修改申请文件的机会，即审查员作出驳回决定时，驳回所依据的事实、理由和证据应当在之前的审查意见通知书中已经告知过申请人。

paras.en: A decision of refusal should generally be made only after a second Office action.
paras.zh: 驳回决定一般应当在第二次审查意见通知书之后才能作出。

paras.en: If the applicant has amended the application, then even if the amended application still has a defect that could be refused on reasons and evidence already notified, the applicant shall be given another opportunity to submit observations and/or amend as long as the facts on which the refusal is based have changed.
paras.zh: 如果申请人对申请文件进行了修改，即使修改后的申请文件仍然存在用已通知过申请人的理由和证据予以驳回的缺陷，但只要驳回所针对的事实改变，就应当给申请人再一次陈述意见和/或修改申请文件的机会。

phrases.en: the principle of the right to be heard
Office action / examination opinion notice
first Office action
phrases.zh: 第一次审查意见通知书

phrases.en: submit observations / arguments
decision of rejection / refusal decision
the time limit specified (in the Office action)

units.label: 第二部分第八章 5.2.1.1
units.title: Scope of amendments (Article 33)
units.titleZh: 修改的内容与范围（专利法第三十三条）

paras.en: Whether an amendment is made voluntarily or in response to defects pointed out in an Office action, it may not go beyond the scope of disclosure contained in the original description and claims.
paras.zh: 不论申请人对申请文件的修改属于主动修改还是针对通知书指出的缺陷进行的修改，都不得超出原说明书和权利要求书记载的范围。

paras.en: The scope of disclosure contained in the original description and claims includes what is literally stated in them and what can be directly and unambiguously determined from that wording and the drawings.
paras.zh: 原说明书和权利要求书记载的范围包括原说明书和权利要求书文字记载的内容和根据原说明书和权利要求书文字记载的内容以及说明书附图能直接地、毫无疑义地确定的内容。

phrases.en: the amendment goes beyond the original disclosure (US: new matter; EPO: added matter)
directly and unambiguously derivable
phrases.zh: 直接地、毫无疑义地确定

phrases.en: a voluntary amendment
the amendment does not comply with Article 33 of the Patent Law
phrases.zh: 修改不符合专利法第三十三条的规定

units.label: 第二部分第十章 3.1
units.title: Sufficient disclosure of chemical product inventions
units.titleZh: 化学产品发明的充分公开

paras.en: Where the claimed invention is a chemical product itself, the description shall set out the identification of the product, its preparation and its use.
paras.zh: 要求保护的发明为化学产品本身的，说明书中应当记载化学产品的确认、化学产品的制备以及化学产品的用途。

paras.en: For a chemical product invention, the description shall set out at least one method of preparation, stating the starting materials, process steps and conditions, special equipment and so on, so that a person skilled in the art can carry it out.
paras.zh: 对于化学产品发明，说明书中应当记载至少一种制备方法，说明实施所述方法所用的原料物质、工艺步骤和条件、专用设备等，使本领域的技术人员能够实施。

paras.en: For a compound invention, a preparation example is normally required.
paras.zh: 对于化合物发明，通常需要有制备实施例。

phrases.en: identification, preparation and use
a preparation example (working example)
experimental data on the effect (pharmacological data)

units.label: 第二部分第十章 3.5
units.title: Post-filing experimental data
units.titleZh: 补交的实验数据

paras.en: Whether the description is sufficiently disclosed is judged on the basis of what is stated in the original description and claims.
paras.zh: 判断说明书是否充分公开，以原说明书和权利要求书记载的内容为准。

paras.en: Experimental data submitted by the applicant after the filing date to meet the requirements of Article 22(3), Article 26(3) and others of the Patent Law shall be examined by the examiner.
paras.zh: 对于申请日之后申请人为满足专利法第二十二条第三款、第二十六条第三款等要求补交的实验数据，审查员应当予以审查。

paras.en: The technical effect proved by post-filing data shall be one that a person skilled in the art can derive from what the patent application discloses.
paras.zh: 补交实验数据所证明的技术效果应当是所属技术领域的技术人员能够从专利申请公开的内容中得到的。

phrases.en: post-filing (supplementary) experimental data
can be derived from the disclosure of the application
phrases.zh: 能够从专利申请公开的内容中得到

phrases.en: comparative experimental data

units.label: 第二部分第十章 4.5.2
units.title: Medical use claims
units.titleZh: 物质的医药用途权利要求

paras.en: If a medical use of a substance is claimed as “for treating a disease”, “for diagnosing a disease” or “use as a medicament”, it falls under Article 25, paragraph 1(3), of the Patent Law — “methods for the diagnosis or treatment of diseases” — and cannot be granted;
paras.zh: 物质的医药用途如果以“用于治病”“用于诊断病”“作为药物的应用”等这样的权利要求申请专利，则属于专利法第二十五条第一款第（三）项“疾病的诊断和治疗方法”，因此不能被授予专利权；

paras.en: Such use claims of the pharmaceutical-preparation type may be written, for example, as “use of compound X in the manufacture of a medicament for treating disease Y” or in a similar form.
paras.zh: 上述的属于制药方法类型的用途权利要求可撰写成例如“化合物X作为制备治疗Y病药物的应用”或者与此类似的形式。

phrases.en: a Swiss-type claim: use of X in the manufacture of a medicament for treating Y
phrases.zh: 制药用途权利要求（瑞士型）

phrases.en: a method of treating Y comprising administering X (patentable in the US, not in China)
methods for the diagnosis or treatment of diseases
phrases.zh: 疾病的诊断和治疗方法

units.label: 第二部分第十章 5.1、5.4
units.title: Novelty of compounds and medical uses
units.titleZh: 化合物与医药用途的新颖性

paras.en: (2) A general formula does not destroy the novelty of a specific compound within it.
paras.zh: （2）通式不能破坏该通式中一个具体化合物的新颖性。

paras.en: The disclosure of a specific compound destroys the novelty of a general-formula claim covering it, but does not affect the novelty of the other compounds covered by the formula.
paras.zh: 一个具体化合物的公开使包括该具体化合物的通式权利要求丧失新颖性，但不影响该通式所包括的除该具体化合物以外的其他化合物的新颖性。

paras.en: (4) whether features related to use — the subject, mode and route of administration, dosage and dosing interval — have a limiting effect on the process of preparing the medicament.
paras.zh: （4）给药对象、给药方式、途径、用量及时间间隔等与使用有关的特征是否对制药过程具有限定作用。

paras.en: Distinguishing features that are reflected only in the course of administration cannot make the use novel.
paras.zh: 仅仅体现在用药过程中的区别特征不能使该用途具有新颖性。

phrases.en: compounds of general formula (Markush formula)
dosage regimen (dose, dosing interval)
limits the process of preparing the medicament
phrases.zh: 对制药过程具有限定作用

phrases.en: is reflected only in the course of administration

units.label: 第二部分第十章 6.1
units.title: Inventiveness of compounds
units.titleZh: 化合物的创造性

paras.en: (1) To judge the inventiveness of a compound, the structural difference between the claimed compound and the closest prior-art compound shall be identified, the technical problem actually solved shall be determined from the use and/or effect obtained by that structural modification, and on that basis it shall be judged whether the prior art as a whole suggests making the modification to solve the problem.
paras.zh: （1）判断化合物发明的创造性，需要确定要求保护的化合物与最接近现有技术化合物之间的结构差异，并基于进行这种结构改造所获得的用途和/或效果确定发明实际解决的技术问题，在此基础上，判断现有技术整体上是否给出了通过这种结构改造以解决所述技术问题的技术启示。

paras.en: If the change in use and/or the improvement in effect is unexpected, this shows that the claimed compound is non-obvious, and its inventiveness shall be acknowledged.
paras.zh: 在判断化合物创造性时，如果这种用途的改变和/或效果的改进是预料不到的，则反映了要求保护的化合物是非显而易见的，应当认可其创造性。

paras.en: (3) It should be noted that if the effect of the claimed solution results from a known, inevitable trend, the solution is not inventive.
paras.zh: （3）需要说明的是，判断化合物发明的创造性时，如果要求保护的技术方案的效果是已知的必然趋势所导致的，则该技术方案没有创造性。

phrases.en: structural modification
the closest prior-art compound (US: lead compound)
phrases.zh: 最接近现有技术化合物

phrases.en: a known, inevitable trend
its inventiveness shall be acknowledged

units.label: 第二部分第十章 9.1.2.2
units.title: Genes and DNA fragments
units.titleZh: 基因或者 DNA 片段

paras.en: However, a gene or DNA fragment isolated or extracted from nature for the first time, whose base sequence has not been recorded in the prior art, which can be precisely characterized and which has industrial value, is — together with the method of obtaining it — patentable subject matter.
paras.zh: 但是，如果是首次从自然界分离或者提取出来的基因或者DNA片段，其碱基序列是现有技术中不曾记载的，并能被确切地表征，且在产业上有利用价值，则该基因或者DNA片段本身及其得到方法均属于可给予专利保护的客体。

phrases.en: isolated or extracted from nature for the first time
phrases.zh: 首次从自然界分离或者提取

phrases.en: can be precisely characterized
has industrial applicability / industrial value
a scientific discovery
